fields.description: Automatic series for the deployment number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The terms this deployment runs against: what the work is, what a volunteer must hold to join it, and where it may be used.
fields.label: Terms of Reference

fields.description: Where this deployment sits in the organisation. Decides who can see it, and must fall inside the terms of reference's own area.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: The person answerable for this deployment: who volunteers ask, and whose contact details go on every invitation. Required, because a deployment nobody is named against is one a volunteer in the field has nobody to ring.
fields.label: Responsible Coordinator

fields.description: Where the deployment has got to. Suspended is a pause somebody intends to lift; Closed Out is Completed plus the paperwork. Cancelled and Closed Out are final.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Planned
Active
Suspended
Completed
Closed Out
Cancelled

fields.description: How many volunteers this deployment needs. Once that many are on the roster, no more can be added. Zero means no limit.
fields.label: Volunteers Required

fields.description: Your own wording for the message a volunteer receives when they are asked to join. Optional.
fields.label: Email Template

fields.description: When the deployment is planned to begin, to the hour.
fields.label: Planned Start

fields.description: The day the deployment begins. Derived from the planned start and shown here because every register in this app windows on days; edit the planned start above.
fields.label: Start Date

fields.description: When it is planned to end. Must not fall before the planned start.
fields.label: Planned End

fields.description: The day the deployment ends. Derived from the planned end.
fields.label: End Date

fields.description: When the team is briefed. Carried on every invitation, because it is the time a volunteer actually has to be somewhere.
fields.label: Briefing

fields.description: By when somebody who is going has to have checked in on site.
fields.label: Check-in Deadline

fields.description: When the team is expected back. What a family or a branch desk is told.
fields.label: Expected Return

fields.description: When it actually began. Recorded afterwards; blank until it does.
fields.label: Actual Start

fields.description: When it actually ended.
fields.label: Actual End

fields.description: What the society calls the place the work happens.
fields.label: Deployment Point

fields.description: Where it is, in words. What the geocoder is given when there are no coordinates.
fields.label: Address or Description

fields.description: Filled in by geocoding, or dropped by hand. A pin set by hand is never overwritten.
fields.label: Latitude

fields.description: When these coordinates were last resolved from the address. Blank where somebody placed the pin themselves.
fields.label: Located On

fields.description: Where the team gathers before going on. Often not the same place as the work.
fields.label: Meeting Point

fields.description: How to travel, what to bring, what the road is like. Carried on every invitation.
fields.label: Travel Notes

fields.description: Somebody at the other end. Not the coordinator: the person on site.
fields.label: Local Contact

fields.description: No longer used. The roster is now a register of deployment assignments, one per person.
fields.label: Roster (superseded)

fields.description: What has happened on this deployment, in order. The author and time are stamped automatically.
fields.label: Updates

fields.description: Anything the coordinator needs to record about this deployment that is not a field.
fields.label: Notes

fields.description: Why the last material change was made. Required once anybody has been invited: a volunteer who arranged their week around a date is owed a sentence when it moves. Every one of these is kept in the deployment's own feed.
fields.label: Reason For The Last Change

fields.description: Recorded automatically when the deployment is closed out.
fields.label: Closed Out On

fields.description: What the society would do differently. Optional, and closing out never waits for it.
fields.label: Lessons Learned

fields.description: The mission report, if one was written. Optional.
fields.label: Mission Report
